title: BIT: prove zero clean pairing at every alternate-carrier helper cut
body:
## Summary
Source-scoped negative theorem for the retained #7001/#6726 BIT word; closes the alternate-carrier ownership case complementary to #7304.

## Result
All 4,521 eligible bank/group contexts have zero clean endpoint pairing (3,908 cocharted banks; 76 local-only false positives). Extends to arbitrary finite block multiplicity and ordered linear operators.

## Verification
Independent kernel/rank engines, exact rational row-space checks, toy positives and mutation controls. Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-alternate-carrier-split-bound`.

## Scope and kappa
Fixed word and paid interface only; changed words/frames, mixed groups, nonlinear recoding and extra paid transfers remain open. No new supplier or kappa. All five foundational assumptions remain.

## Credit and details
Original #7001/#6726 and #7304 credit/notices retained. Prepared for @CubeJerry with OpenAI assistance; original notices retained. See `research/bit-alternate-carrier-split-bound/PR-DESCRIPTION.md` and `VALIDATION.json` for full proof, pins and controls. Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; no independent human/formal acceptance claimed.
